D: John takes on the High Table across the world for one last shot at freedom.
P: Serve the mains when the fight reaches the steps of Paris at sunrise.
S: Crisp golden octopus balls with spring onion and pickled ginger, drizzled with tangy okonomiyaki sauce and Japanese mayo, topped with dancing bonito flakes. Whisk 200g plain flour, 2 eggs, 600ml water and 1 tsp dashi powder into a thin batter. Heat an oiled takoyaki pan until smoking, fill the holes, then drop in 200g diced cooked octopus, sliced spring onion and pickled ginger. Cook 2 minutes, then turn each ball with a skewer every minute until round and crisp, about 6 minutes. Drizzle with okonomiyaki sauce and Japanese mayo and top with bonito flakes and nori.
Sliced grilled bratwurst in curry tomato sauce, dusted with curry powder
Bratwurst grilled and sliced, covered in a sauce of tomato, curry powder, onion and a little sugar and vinegar, dusted with more curry powder. Fries.
Light choux pastry puffs baked with gruyère and nutmeg
Choux pastry with gruyère piped in rounds, baked at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed and hollow, served warm.
M: Pan seared sirloin in peppercorn brandy cream, with thin cut fries
Sirloin dry-brined overnight, seared hard in cast iron, pulled at 54C and rested, with a peppercorn sauce of crushed pepper, cognac and cream reduced in the same pan, and thin fries cooked twice.
a late night in the Osaka hotel kitchen

Thick savoury cabbage pancakes crisped under thin pork belly slices, flipped and lacquered with okonomiyaki sauce, mayo, bonito flakes and pickled ginger. Whisk 200g plain flour, 250ml water, 1 tsp dashi powder and 4 eggs. Fold in half a wombok, finely shredded, and 4 sliced spring onions. Heat an oiled pan, add a quarter of the batter, press into a thick round and lay 3 thin slices of pork belly on top. Cook 5 minutes, flip and cook 5 more until the pork crisps. Repeat. Brush with okonomiyaki sauce, zigzag with mayo and top with bonito, nori and pickled ginger.
W: Croissant and dark chocolate baked in vanilla custard
Stale croissants torn into a dish, soaked in an egg and cream custard with dark chocolate, baked at 170C for 35 minutes.
K: Cognac, orange liqueur and lemon shaken and strained into a sugar rimmed coupe

Cognac shaken hard with orange liqueur and fresh lemon, strained into a chilled coupe with a fine sugared rim and a twist of orange. Rub the rims of four chilled coupes with lemon and dip in caster sugar. For each drink, shake 50ml cognac, 20ml orange liqueur and 20ml fresh lemon juice hard with ice for 15 seconds. Strain into the coupe and twist a strip of orange peel over the top.

s.note: Sliced grilled bratwurst in curry tomato sauce, dusted with curry powder
s.how: Grill 4 bratwurst slowly until browned, then slice. Soften 1 onion, add 3 tbsp tomato paste, 2 tsp curry powder, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tbsp vinegar and 200ml water and simmer 10 minutes. Pour over and dust with curry powder. Serve with 600g potatoes fried as chips.

s.note: Light choux pastry puffs baked with gruyère and nutmeg
s.how: Boil 125ml water with 50g butter, beat in 75g flour and stir over heat for a minute. Cool slightly, beat in 2 eggs one at a time, then 80g grated gruyère and a little nutmeg. Pipe small rounds and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.

m.note: Pan seared sirloin in peppercorn brandy cream, with thin cut fries
m.how: Dry-brine 4 sirloins overnight. Fry 1kg potatoes cut thin, at 140C then 185C. Sear the steaks hard in cast iron, pull at 54C and rest. In the pan, crush 1 tbsp peppercorns, flame 60ml brandy and add 200ml cream, then reduce until it coats a spoon.

w.note: Croissant and dark chocolate baked in vanilla custard
w.how: Tear 6 stale croissants into a buttered dish and scatter with 100g chopped dark chocolate. Whisk 3 eggs, 300ml cream, 200ml milk and 60g sugar and pour over. Rest 20 minutes, then bake at 170C for 35 minutes until puffed and just set.

d.note: Cognac, orange liqueur and lemon shaken and strained into a sugar rimmed coupe
d.how: Rub the rims of four chilled coupes with lemon and dip in caster sugar. For each drink, shake 50ml cognac, 20ml orange liqueur and 20ml fresh lemon juice hard with ice for 15 seconds. Strain into the coupe and twist a strip of orange peel over the top.
